name: Opening: Formas de Corte
description: Catch the opening night of this new exhibition by Rosinda Casais, presented alongside the Américo Moura retrospective.
longDescription:
The Cooperativa Árvore hosts the opening of "Formas de Corte," a new art exhibition by Rosinda Casais. This presentation runs concurrently with a retrospective dedicated to Américo Moura, offering a dual exploration of contemporary and historical artistic perspectives within the same space. Casais's work for "Formas de Corte" focuses on [OMIT - *no information provided on subject matter or curatorial angle*], providing a new body of work for public viewing.

Visitors are invited to attend the opening night on August 14, 2026, to experience the new exhibition in the setting of Cooperativa Árvore. The event is free to attend, encouraging a broad audience to engage with the art. The Cooperativa Árvore is a well-established cultural institution in Porto, known for its commitment to showcasing diverse artistic practices.

Admission to the opening is free, and walk-ins are welcome. The Cooperativa Árvore is located in central Porto, accessible via the Aliados metro station, approximately a 7-minute walk away. Several bus lines also serve the area.
